text:
Priya: quick one — on narrow viewports the left rail collapse animation is making the table header jump under the topbar. spotted in yesterday's usability session. anyone seen this before?

Jon: yes saw it too. users notice header getting occluded when the sidebar animates. feels like a stacking context change. :confused:

Alex: probably because the nav uses `transform: translateX()` during the animation. transforms create a new stacking context so sticky headers can end up underneath.

Marta: from an a11y POV keyboard focus is annoying: when the nav collapses the focus outline disappears (it moves into the hidden nav). we should move focus to the primary content region.

Priya: proposed approach: 1) make table header `position: sticky` with explicit `top` and high z-index; 2) animate nav with `max-width` instead of `transform`; 3) add a short aria-live message when layout changes.

Alex: note that animating `max-width` can be choppy on mobile. alternative: animate an inner wrapper width while keeping the outer nav at full width but pointer-events:none when collapsed. also `will-change: max-width` helps. small CSS snippet: 
```
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .left-rail { max-width: 240px; transition: max-width .18s ease; overflow: hidden; }
  .left-rail.collapsed { max-width: 0; }
  .table__header { position: sticky; top: 56px; z-index: 900; }
}
```

Jon: breakpoint suggestion: icon-only at <920px, fully hidden at <640px. keeps parity with mobile tokens.

Marta: copy nits: toggle label currently says "Hide nav" in tooltip; we should standardize to "Collapse sidebar". also we have mixed verbs in overflow actions — sometimes "More", sometimes "Show more". prefer "Show more".

Priya: good call. also ensure toggle button has `aria-expanded` and live region is off-screen but accessible. aria-live message could be: "Layout changed: sidebar collapsed" so screen readers know content shifted.

design-bot: FYI icon pack v3 pushed to /design/icons — collapsed state uses new caret icon :package: 

Alex: I'll open a tiny PR with the sticky header and aria-live region. will try the wrapper-width trick to reduce jank.

Jon: one more question: should horizontal swipe on table rows collapse nav? during testing people accidentally collapsed it while swiping rows for actions.

Marta: definitely not. narrow the swipe area to the nav itself and prefer a discrete handle for collapse. row swipe should remain for row-level actions only.

Priya: decision noted: swipe-to-collapse limited to the nav area only, tooltip copy changed to "Collapse sidebar", standardize overflow labels to "Show more", and add keyboard focus move to main region when nav toggles. I'll update the Figma spec and attach micro-interaction notes. :white_check_mark:
